old_definition_en: A logical data type representing true or false.
new_definition_en: A data type whose values are TRUE or FALSE.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A data type containing one alphanumeric character.
new_definition_en: A data type representing a single character.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A data type representing a calendar date.
new_definition_en: A data type representing a valid calendar date.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A data type for whole numbers, including positive, negative and zero values.
new_definition_en: A data type representing whole numbers.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A data type for numbers with fractional components.
new_definition_en: A data type representing numbers that can include a fractional part.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A sequence of characters including letters, digits or other symbols.
new_definition_en: A data type representing a sequence of zero or more characters.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.1.1, p.240; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §2.1, p.7; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §2.1, p.7.

old_definition_en: A Boolean function indicating whether the end of a file has been reached.
new_definition_en: A function that returns TRUE when no more lines can be read from a file, and FALSE when more lines remain.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.3, p.249; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §9.1, p.25; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §9.1, p.25.

old_definition_en: A setting determining how an opened file may be read from or written to.
new_definition_en: The access mode selected when a file is opened; READ retrieves data, WRITE writes data and replaces existing contents, and APPEND adds data after existing contents.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.3, p.249; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §9.1, p.25; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §9.1, p.25.

old_definition_en: A file storing a sequence of characters that may include end-of-line markers.
new_definition_en: A file that stores text as lines, which are read or written consecutively as strings.
new_source_ref: Hodder 9618 (2019), §10.3, p.249; chapter detail; Drive:17qXAmcDsvLV96ytM5w75MWYNsGw9Buf-; Cambridge 9618 Syllabus (2026), p.28; Cambridge 9618 Pseudocode Guide for Teachers (2026), §9.1, p.25; 2027–2029 Pseudocode Guide, §9.1, p.25.

old_definition_en: A selection construct choosing a branch according to the value or range of an identifier.
new_definition_en: A selection statement that chooses the first matching branch according to the value of an identifier; an optional OTHERWISE branch runs if no case matches.

old_definition_en: A loop repeating a known number of times with a counter.
new_definition_en: A loop that executes its body for each integer value in a specified range, using a counter.

old_definition_en: A selection construct executing a statement or block only when a condition is true.
new_definition_en: A selection statement that executes the THEN branch when a Boolean condition is TRUE and, when provided, the ELSE branch when it is FALSE.

old_definition_en: An IF statement placed inside another IF or ELSE branch, allowing the program to make an additional decision only when that branch is reached.
new_definition_en: An IF statement placed inside another IF or ELSE branch to test an additional condition within that branch.

old_definition_en: A repetition structure checking its stopping condition after the body executes.
new_definition_en: A loop that tests its Boolean condition after executing its body, so the body runs at least once.

old_definition_en: A repetition structure checking its condition before running the body.
new_definition_en: A loop that tests its Boolean condition before each iteration; if the condition is FALSE initially, the body does not run.
